audio_text: Let's assume your monthly income were to somehow double.

frames.description: a man in a suit and tie is standing with his hands out
a man holding money bags with a dollar sign

audio_text: You can now for the most part afford to buy two times more stuff.

frames.description: a man sitting in a chair with a plate of food

audio_text: But what if the monthly income of everyone else were to also double?

frames.description: how to make money from 2x more income

audio_text: Well, in that case, you'd no longer be able to buy two times more stuff, because since
everyone else also earns two times more, there would be two times more money chasing
roughly the same number of goods.

frames.description: two people running away from a bag of food

audio_text: Let's take things one step further.
What if your income doubles, but the income of everyone else triples?

frames.description: a cartoon character with a lot of money

audio_text: In that case, you'd actually become poorer.
